items.description: Prepare a claim regarding the discrepancy of 280 mt between the weighbridge figure and the discharge draft survey for vessel VSL-13.
Verify and reconcile the load draft survey and discharge draft survey data for vessel VSL-13, noting the figures of 61,170 mt and 61,070 mt respectively.
Arrange for a survey to assess the weighbridge calibration certificate requested from the receiver in relation to the discharge draft survey for vessel VSL-13.
